This is a speculative inference not grounded in the actual visual data — the ground truth shows specific, non-uniform color assignments per cube face, which the model ignored. The model failed to recognize that the cubes have fixed, pre-assigned colors on specific faces (e.g., Cube 2 has purple on LEFT, RIGHT, and UP), and instead treated color distribution as arbitrary and deducible from visible faces only.
